description: Source code for an event handling module based on the select() system call, part of Redis's asynchronous event loop implementation.

methods.name: aeApiCreate
methods.description: Initializes the aeApiState structure and associates it with the event loop.

methods.name: aeApiResize
methods.description: Ensures the fd_set can handle the specified size, returns -1 if size exceeds FD_SETSIZE.

methods.name: aeApiFree
methods.description: Frees the allocated api data associated with the event loop.

methods.name: aeApiAddEvent
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor to the read/write fd_sets based on the mask.

methods.name: aeApiDelEvent
methods.description: Removes a file descriptor from the read/write fd_sets based on the mask.

methods.name: aeApiPoll
methods.description: Performs the select() system call to detect ready file descriptors and updates the fired events.

methods.name: aeApiName
methods.description: Returns the name of the polling method, 'select'.
